name: SEOBot AI – SEO Automation, Content Optimizer & Internal Linking
author: TheNewAIGuru

sections.description:
SEOBot AI is the most complete AI-powered SEO automation plugin for WordPress. It replaces 5+ separate SEO tools with one intelligent dashboard that analyzes, optimizes, and grows your organic traffic — all on autopilot.

Whether you run a blog, an eCommerce store, or a business website, SEOBot AI works 24/7 to improve your content, fix technical SEO issues, and uncover opportunities your competitors are missing.

🏆 Trusted by content creators, agencies, and businesses to save 10+ hours per week on SEO tasks.

🚀 Why SEOBot AI?

  • One plugin replaces many — Internal linking, content generation, keyword research, E-E-A-T scoring, Google Search Console analytics, backlink outreach, category auditing, and author optimization — all in one place.
  • AI-powered, human-controlled — Every suggestion can be reviewed, edited, and approved before applying. Nothing changes without your consent.
  • Safe by design — Automatic backups before every change. One-click restore with side-by-side diff viewer.
  • Works with any theme and any SEO plugin — Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress — SEOBot AI complements them all.

✨ Key Features

🔗 Intelligent Internal Linking
Stop building links manually. SEOBot AI scans your entire site and suggests contextually relevant internal links with AI-generated anchor texts. Apply individually or in bulk.

✍️ AI Article Creator
Generate complete, SEO-optimized articles in 3 steps: Topic → Outline → Publish. Includes AI image generation (8 style presets), YouTube video embeds, FAQ sections, and configurable tone and word count (1,000–5,000 words).

📊 Keyword Research & Suggestions (Google Ads)
Get real keyword data — search volume, CPC, competition scores — directly in your dashboard. Extract seed keywords automatically from your posts or search manually.

📈 Google Search Console Integration
Connect your Google Search Console account to view search performance, discover keyword opportunities, and identify pages that need attention — without leaving WordPress.

📝 Content Planner
Plan your editorial calendar with AI. Generate content plans based on high-potential keywords, manage article statuses, and go from idea to published post in minutes.

🏅 E-E-A-T Scorer
Evaluate your content against Google’s Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness guidelines. Get actionable recommendations to improve your E-E-A-T signals.

👥 Users / Author Optimizer
Audit every author profile on your site. AI analyzes bios, display names, avatars, and posting activity, then generates optimized author descriptions to boost E-E-A-T.

📂 Categories Optimizer
Audit your entire category taxonomy. Get AI-powered keep / delete / merge verdicts for every category, auto-generate SEO descriptions, and clean up empty or duplicate categories.

🔄 Duplicate & Cannibalization Detection
Find posts competing for the same keywords. AI identifies duplicate content, suggests merges, and automatically sets up 301 redirects to preserve link equity.

📅 Smart Date Updater
Keep evergreen content fresh. Automatically scans and updates outdated year references across all posts (e.g., “Best of 2024” → “Best of 2026”).

✏️ AI Content Enrichment
Score existing content quality (0–100) and get AI suggestions for new sections, FAQs, statistics, and better headings. Apply improvements one by one or rewrite entire posts.

🔗 Backlink Exchange Network
Join an opt-in backlink exchange program. Get matched with relevant sites in your niche and place contextual backlinks automatically with AI-powered content integration.

💾 Version History & Backups
Every AI change is backed up automatically. Browse version history, compare changes in a side-by-side diff viewer, and restore any previous version with one click.

🧙 AI-Powered Setup Wizard
Get started in under 2 minutes. The wizard analyzes your entire site — posts, pages, categories, menus — and configures the AI to match your brand voice, niche, and target audience.

📋 Activity Log
Full audit trail of every action SEOBot AI takes. Filter by type, date, or post. Complete transparency.

🎯 Who Is SEOBot AI For?

  • Bloggers & Content Creators — Automate the tedious SEO work and focus on writing.
  • Small Business Owners — Get enterprise-level SEO without hiring an agency.
  • SEO Agencies — Manage multiple client sites faster with bulk actions and AI automation.
  • eCommerce Stores — Optimize product categories, internal linking, and content at scale.
  • WordPress Developers — Offer SEO optimization as a value-added service to clients.

🔧 How It Works

  1. Install & Configure — Activate the plugin, run the Setup Wizard, and your site will be automatically registered with the SEOBot AI API.
  2. Analyze — SEOBot AI scans your posts, categories, users, and site structure.
  3. Optimize — Review AI suggestions and apply improvements with one click.
  4. Monitor — Track performance with Google Search Console integration and the activity log.

🌐 External Services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services:

SEOBot AI API (seobot-api.domnam.workers.dev)
All AI-powered features (content generation, analysis, scoring, keyword suggestions, image generation, and backlink exchange) are processed through the SEOBot AI API server. When you activate the plugin, your site URL, site name, and admin email are sent to register your site and obtain an API key. Post content, titles, and metadata are sent for AI analysis and generation.

  • Service URL: https://seobot-api.domnam.workers.dev
  • Website: https://seobot-api.domnam.workers.dev
  • Terms of Service: https://seobot-api.domnam.workers.dev/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://seobot-api.domnam.workers.dev/privacy

Google APIs (googleapis.com)
When you connect Google Search Console or Google Ads for keyword research, the plugin communicates with Google APIs using your OAuth credentials. Search performance data (queries, clicks, impressions, positions) is retrieved and displayed in your dashboard.

  • Google APIs Terms: https://developers.google.com/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  • Classic Editor & Gutenberg

  • Internal linking analysis & automation
  • AI content enrichment & scoring

  • Full backup & restore system
  • Setup wizard
  • Activity log

  • Google Ads keyword research

  • Categories Optimizer
  • Backlink Exchange Network
  • Priority support
sections.installation:
From your WordPress Dashboard:

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for SEOBot AI
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Navigate to SEOBot AI → Setup Wizard to configure the plugin

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin and run the Setup Wizard

After Activation:

  1. The plugin automatically registers with the SEOBot AI API and obtains an API key
  2. Run the Setup Wizard to configure the plugin for your site
  3. Optionally add Google Ads credentials for keyword research
  4. Optionally connect Google Search Console for search analytics
  5. Start analyzing your content from the Dashboard
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key?

No. SEOBot AI handles all AI processing through its own API server (seobot-api.domnam.workers.dev). When you activate the plugin, it automatically registers your site and obtains an API key. You don’t need to create or manage any external API keys yourself.

How much does the AI cost?

All AI features are included in the plugin. Free-tier users get a generous daily allowance. Premium plans offer higher limits for larger sites and agencies. See the Upgrade page inside the plugin for details.

Does this plugin replace Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

No — SEOBot AI complements your existing SEO plugin. Yoast/Rank Math handle on-page meta tags and sitemaps. SEOBot AI handles the heavy lifting: AI content creation, internal linking automation, keyword research, E-E-A-T optimization, and taxonomy auditing.

Will it break my existing content?

Never. SEOBot AI automatically creates a backup before modifying any post. You can review every change in the side-by-side diff viewer and restore any previous version with one click.

What is the E-E-A-T Scorer?

E-E-A-T stands for Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness — Google’s quality guidelines for ranking content. The E-E-A-T Scorer evaluates your posts against these criteria and gives you specific recommendations to improve.

What is the Categories Optimizer?

It audits your entire category taxonomy and uses AI to recommend which categories to keep, delete, or merge. It also generates SEO-optimized descriptions, identifies empty/thin categories, and scores each category for SEO health.

What is the Users / Author Optimizer?

It scans every WordPress user profile and identifies SEO issues — missing bios, short descriptions, display names that match usernames, no avatar, inactive accounts. AI then generates optimized author bios that improve E-E-A-T signals.

Can I connect Google Search Console?

Yes! Go to Settings → Google Search Console and follow the setup guide to connect via OAuth 2.0. Once connected, you can view search performance data and discover keyword opportunities directly in WordPress.

Is the Backlink Exchange safe?

The Backlink Exchange is completely opt-in. You control which niches you accept links from, whether links are DoFollow or NoFollow, and you can exclude competitor domains. All placed links use AI for contextual integration, and you can remove all exchange links instantly by opting out.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. SEOBot AI works with WooCommerce product posts, categories, and pages just like regular WordPress content.

Can I use it on multiple sites?

Yes, the plugin can be installed on as many WordPress sites as you need. Each site is automatically registered with the SEOBot AI API and receives its own API key.

How do I get keyword research data?

Keyword data is powered by the Google Ads Keyword Planner API. Set up a Google Ads account, create API credentials in the Google Cloud Console, add them in Settings, and keyword metrics (search volume, CPC, competition) will appear throughout the plugin.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your content remains unchanged. All backup data, logs, and settings are preserved. If you uninstall (delete) the plugin, you’ll be prompted to clean up all plugin data from the database.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

SEOBot AI sends post content to the SEOBot AI API server (seobot-api.domnam.workers.dev) for AI processing. No personal visitor data is collected or transmitted. See the External Services section above and our Privacy Policy for full compliance details.

How often is SEOBot AI updated?

We release updates regularly with new features, bug fixes, and compatibility improvements. The plugin is actively maintained and tested with the latest WordPress releases.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2 – 2026-04-14

  • Fix: Fallback API registration for WordPress.org repository installations
  • Fix: Rate limiting behavior for non-POST requests

1.1.0 – 2026-02-21

New Features:
* Google Search Console Integration — Connect via OAuth 2.0, view search performance (impressions, clicks, CTR, position), discover keyword opportunities, and select properties — all from within WordPress.
* E-E-A-T Scorer — AI-powered evaluation of your content against Google’s Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness guidelines with detailed scoring and actionable recommendations.
* Content Planner — Generate AI-powered editorial calendars with keyword targeting, manage article statuses (planned, approved, generating, published), and go from plan to published post seamlessly.
* Users / Author Optimizer — Audit all WordPress user profiles for SEO issues (missing bio, short description, no avatar, inactive accounts). AI generates optimized bios and display names to boost E-E-A-T.
* Categories Optimizer — Full taxonomy audit with AI-powered keep/delete/merge verdicts, auto-generated SEO descriptions, empty category detection, and bulk actions.
* Backlink Exchange Network — Opt-in program for exchanging contextual backlinks with niche-relevant WordPress sites. Includes questionnaire, niche matching, quality controls, and AI-powered link placement.
* Addons Marketplace — Discover and manage premium add-ons directly from the plugin dashboard.
* Upgrade Page — Compare Free vs. Pro features with detailed plan comparison.

Improvements:
* Updated AI model support — Added GPT-4o-mini, o1, o1-mini, o3-mini, and GPT-5 model options.
* Setup Wizard now auto-detects site language and configures AI accordingly.
* Improved modal design system — Uniform modal UI across all plugin pages.
* Enhanced Article Creator with 8 image style presets and custom prompt support.
* Better error handling and retry logic for AI API calls.
* Activity Log now shows detailed action metadata with expandable rows.
* Improved responsive design across all admin pages.

Bug Fixes:
* Fixed duplicate PHP opening tag in Keywords template causing fatal error.
* Fixed JavaScript object syntax error in Settings page preventing GSC connection.
* Fixed stuck “Generating…” state in Content Planner when AI request fails.

1.0.0 – 2025-10-01

  • Initial release.
  • Dashboard with site overview and quick actions.
  • Posts Analysis with AI scoring, internal linking, and content enrichment.
  • AI Article Creator — full article generation with outline, images, and video.
  • Keyword Research via Google Ads Keyword Planner integration.
  • Smart Date Updater for evergreen content.
  • Duplicate / Cannibalization Detection with AI merge.
  • Version History & Backup system with diff viewer.
  • AI-Powered Setup Wizard.
  • Activity Log with full audit trail.
  • Settings page with API configuration and image style presets.
